findings.claim: The rank defined by removing delta H0(N[omega]) agrees for every abelian variety twist with the usual rank removing all rational torsion.
findings.check: Q, ell=2, trivial twist, E:y^2=x^3+4x. P=(2,4), 2P=(0,0). Good reduction counts 4 at3 and8 at5 prove rational torsion C4. E(Q)[4]→E(Q)[2] is onto so finite-level delta image zero; full torsion Kummer image has dimension1. The two ranks differ by1 at k=1.
findings.all_counterexample_hypotheses: Positive-dimensional abelian variety, discriminant -4096, N=E[2∞] twistable, continuous trivial character permitted, usual local conditions, V0 may be enlarged to unpack.
findings.counterevidence: Definition4.7 nonempty generating ramification at a prime outsideV0 forces all Nchi invariants killed byomega; Proposition4.8 p26 explicitly uses this equality. The main grid theorem excludes this example.
findings.impact: Unrestricted comparison is false; no demonstrated main distribution failure.
findings.repair: Restrict comparison to twists with rational omega-primary torsion killed byomega; larger redefinition not certified.

focused_acceptance.reason: For E/Q:y^2=x^3+4x, P=(2,4) has 2P=(0,0). Good reductions have #E(F_3)=4 and #E(F_5)=8, yielding E(Q)_tors=C4 with no odd torsion and no rational point of order 8. The finite connecting image E(Q)[2] -> H^1(Q,E[2]) is zero because rational 4-torsion maps onto E(Q)[2], whereas the full torsion Kummer image has dimension one because P is not twice a rational point. Thus for the trivial twist the two printed rank conventions differ by one, contradicting unrestricted Example 4.4. New ramification in the actual grids forces rational omega-primary invariants to be killed by omega; in that range the two torsion portions agree. This supports Minor, the stated sufficient repair, and no claim of a global redefinition or main theorem counterexample.
